subject: Request: temporary scaling surcharge & reconciliation for May launch
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@launchlabs.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: launchlabs-billing@launchlabs.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary scaling surcharge & reconciliation for May launch

Hi Dylan / Ben,

Quick note from LaunchLabs — we hit a sharp increase in inference demand yesterday during our feature rollout and started seeing throttles around 13:00 PDT. We've attached a CSV with token and request-level breakdown for the last 10 days (usage_report_May2027.csv).

We need a short-term uplift for the next seven days to avoid repeated throttling while we stabilize autoscaling on our side. Can you outline: 1) an option for a temporary quota bump (preferably same-day), 2) what a short-term surcharge would look like for the uplift period, and 3) if there's a path to a partial credit/true-up if throttling caused customer-visible errors? We're open to a temporary surcharge if there's a reconciliation mechanism.

Also, we're evaluating a 6-month committed plan after the launch — if that helps with pricing, say so.

Thanks,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Platform, LaunchLabs
Sanjay.M@launchlabs.ai
Attachment: usage_report_May2027.csv (attachment/csv)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@launchlabs.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, launchlabs-billing@launchlabs.ai
Date: 2027-05-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary scaling surcharge & reconciliation for May launch

Sanjay — thanks for the data, and for the heads-up. We're sorry you ran into throttles during launch.

High-level options we can offer immediately:
- Same-day provisional quota uplift: we can open a temporary "elastic capacity" cushion for 7 days.
- Surcharge model: standard short-term uplift would carry a surcharge. We typically price provisional uplifts as a multiplier on the prevailing unit rate (example table attached).
- Reconciliation / true-up: if you move to a committed plan within 30 days, we can apply a partial credit toward the overrun during the uplift window (subject to contract).

To make the uplift concrete, we need a target request/tokens-per-second target from you so we can size the cushion. If you prefer, we can provision a conservative uplift now and iterate after a brief validation window.

I've attached a provisional_rate_table_v2.pdf with two scenarios: (A) expedited uplift with 1.6x surcharge, same-day enable; (B) uplift + 6-month commit discount path where the first-week surcharge is softened to 1.25x and then amortized into the commit. Both scenarios note PO/procurement requirements for dedicated billing.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm the target qps/peak tokens you want for the 7-day window.
2) If you want the softened surcharge we discussed, confirm intent to sign a 6-month commit within 30 days; we'll draft a one-page addendum for signature.
3) If you want immediate provisioning, we can spin up the cushion within 4–6 hours after PO/approval.

Looping in Monica from CS for a quick validation on the expected traffic pattern and any config hints to reduce tail latency.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
Attachment: provisional_rate_table_v2.pdf (attachment/pdf)

From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@launchlabs.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Clara Ruiz <clara@launchlabs.ai>, launchlabs-billing@launchlabs.ai
Date: 2027-05-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary scaling surcharge & reconciliation for May launch

Thanks, Dylan. Appreciate the quick answer and the rate table.

A few datapoints to help size this:
- Peak requests observed: ~3,200 RPS between 12:30–13:15 PDT yesterday (500k tokens/min peak).
- Expected sustained elevated window for next 72 hours while we monitor traffic routing changes.
- We're prepared to commit to a 6-month $120k/month minimum if we can get favorable reconciliation for this immediate uplift.

On credits: the throttles caused ~45 failed user requests that triggered retries and a brief incident. We'd like to request a partial forgiveness/credit for the customer-impacting portion of the overrun if we proceed with the uplift and commit. Reasoning: we are long-term customers and this was during a controlled launch window; a goodwill credit would go a long way.

Can you confirm whether the softened 1.25x surcharge for week-one is conditional on a signed commit, or if you can offer the same softened rate with a formal letter of intent and PO up front? Also, what invoice timing would look like for the surcharge (immediate vs invoiced with next month billing)?

Sanjay

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@launchlabs.ai>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, launchlabs-billing@launchlabs.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary scaling surcharge & reconciliation for May launch

Hi Sanjay — sorry again about the interruption, and thanks for the clear numbers. Short answer: we can do a compromise that balances speed and commercial fairness.

Proposal we can approve now:
- Immediate 7-day provisional uplift sized to 4,000 RPS (to give ~25% headroom over your observed peak).
- Week-one surcharge: 1.25x on consumed units during uplift window, invoiced in the next monthly bill.
- Reconciliation: if LaunchLabs signs a 6-month commit (minimum $120k/month) within 30 days of uplift, Redwood will issue a credit equal to 40% of the week-one surcharge (applied to the subsequent month's invoice), conditional on no material billing disputes.
- If you instead provide a signed LOI + PO before provisioning, we can hold the softened surcharge in place; the full addendum will still be required within 30 days to convert the LOI to the commit.

Process items:
- I'll open a DocuSign addendum for the provisional uplift and LOI path today.
- Monica will validate the uplift config and sanity-check the traffic pattern so we avoid tail-latency regressions.
- Billing will invoice the uplift surcharge on the next invoice cycle and the credit (if applicable) will be visible on the following cycle.

If that sounds OK, Dylan or Monica will schedule the provisioning immediately after we receive the PO or LOI.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.example.com
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0188
